defs.d: To move with rhythmic steps or movements, especially in time to music.
defs.ex: I danced with her all night long.

defs.d: To leap or move lightly and rapidly.
defs.ex: His eyes danced with pleasure as he spoke.   She accused her political opponent of dancing around the issue instead of confronting it.

defs.d: The activity of taking part in a dance.
A dance club in France.
One’s female offspring.
defs.ex: I already have a son, so I would like to have a daughter.

defs.d: A female descendant.
(chiefly British) An area of land; a district, region.

A set region of land having particular human occupation or agreed limits, especially inhabited by members of the same race, speakers of the same language etc., or associated with a given person, occupation, species etc.
From or in the countryside or connected with it.
Of or connected to country music.
A style of popular music that originated in the folk music of the rural population of the southern and western United States and characterized by string-band instruments and simple melodies.
A section of learning or teaching into which a wider learning content is divided.
defs.ex: In our school a typical working week consists of around twenty lessons and ten hours of related laboratory work.

defs.d: A learning task assigned to a student; homework.
To give a lesson to; to teach.
An activity that one enjoys doing in one's spare time.
defs.ex: I like to collect stamps from different countries as a hobby.

defs.d: An extinct breed of horse native to the British Isles, also known as the Irish Hobby
(heading, physical) To do with shape.
(social) To do with structure or procedure.
To assume (a certain shape or visible structure).
defs.ex: When you kids form a straight line I'll hand out the lollies.

defs.d: To give (a shape or visible structure) to a thing or person.
defs.ex: Roll out the dough to form a thin sheet.

defs.d: Used to indicate source or provenance.
defs.ex: I got a letter from my brother.

defs.d: Originating at (a year, time, etc.)
defs.ex: This manuscript is from the 1980s.

defs.d: Cloth-covered frame used for protection against rain or sun.
defs.ex: Quick, grab that umbrella before you get rained on!

defs.d: Generally, anything that provides protection.
defs.ex: The fighters provide a defensive air umbrella over the battle group.

defs.d: To cover or protect, as if by an umbrella.
To form the dome shape of an open umbrella.
An organization, the objective of which is to carry out a charitable purpose.
The goods or money given to those in need.
To design a new process or mechanism.
defs.ex: After weeks of hard work, I invented a new way to alphabetize matchbooks.

defs.d: To create something fictional for a particular purpose.
defs.ex: I knew I had to invent an excuse, and quickly.

defs.d: A part, portion, or subdivision.
A distinct course of life, action, study, or the like.
defs.ex: Technical things are not his department; he's a people person.

defs.d: Food given to (especially herbivorous) animals.
defs.ex: They sell feed, riding helmets, and everything else for horses.

defs.d: Something supplied continuously.
defs.ex: a satellite feed

defs.d: (ditransitive) To give (someone or something) food to eat.
defs.ex: Feed the dog every evening.

defs.d: To eat (usually of animals).
defs.ex: Spiders feed on gnats and flies.

defs.d: A loud sound or part of a sound.
High-quality marijuana.
(of a sound) Of great intensity.
defs.ex: Turn that music down; it's too loud.

defs.d: (of a person, thing, event, etc.) Noisy.
defs.ex: a loud party that went on all night

defs.d: A water-borne vessel generally larger than a boat.
(chiefly in combination) A vessel which travels through any medium other than across land, such as an airship or spaceship.
The act of applying or laying on, in a literal sense
defs.ex: The application of this cream should reduce the swelling.

defs.d: The substance applied.
A (usually disastrous) overflow of water from a lake or other body of water due to excessive rainfall or other input of water.
A large number or quantity of anything appearing more rapidly than can easily be dealt with.
defs.ex: a flood of complaints

defs.d: To overflow, as by water from excessive rainfall.
To cover or partly fill as if by a flood.
defs.ex: The floor was flooded with beer.

defs.d: To cover, fill, or affect with lead
defs.ex: continuous firing leads the grooves of a rifle.

defs.d: To place leads between the lines of.
defs.ex: leaded matter

defs.d: (heading) To guide or conduct.

To guide or conduct, as by accompanying, going before, showing, influencing, directing with authority, etc.; to have precedence or preeminence; to be first or chief; — used in most of the senses of the transitive verb.
Providing guidance or direction.
defs.ex: Avoid leading questions if you really want the truth.

defs.d: Ranking first.
defs.ex: He is a leading supplier of plumbing supplies in the county.

defs.d: Having, or capable of exerting power, potency or influence.
Large; capacious; said of veins of ore.
To a great extent or degree.
defs.ex: Not very many (of them) had been damaged.

defs.d: Conforming to fact, reality or rule; true.
Total income or cash flow minus expenditures. The money or other benefit a non-governmental organization or individual receives in exchange for products and services sold at an advertised price.
Benefit, positive result obtained.
defs.ex: Reading such an enlightening book on the subject was of much profit to his studies.

defs.d: To benefit (somebody), be of use to (somebody).
(construed with from) To benefit, gain.
Meeting the standards, requirements, and training for a position.
Restricted or limited by conditions.
defs.ex: Assuming that I have all the information, my qualified opinion is that your plan will work.

defs.d: To describe or characterize something by listing its qualities.
To make someone, or to become competent or eligible for some position or task.
A person who gives support to someone or something.
Something that supports another thing.
A plant, especially a cereal, grown to be harvested as food, livestock fodder or fuel or for any other economic purpose.
defs.ex: the farmer had lots of crops to sell at the market

defs.d: The natural production for a specific year, particularly of plants.
defs.ex: it was a good crop of lambs that year

defs.d: Downward movement, fall.
A sloping downward, e.g. of a hill or road.
To move downwards, to fall, to drop.
defs.ex: The dollar has declined rapidly since 2001.

defs.d: To become weaker or worse.
defs.ex: My health declined in winter.

defs.d: To press down.
defs.ex: Depress the upper lever to start the machine.

defs.d: To make depressed, sad or bored.
defs.ex: Winter depresses me.

defs.d: Causing depression or sadness.
defs.ex: The television news was depressing, so rather than start crying I turned it off.

defs.d: Causing a reduction in economic activity.
defs.ex: The policy may have a depressing effect on some branches of industry.

defs.d: (physical) Matter, material.
A large quantity; a sum.
To form or collect into a mass; to form into a collective body; to bring together into masses; to assemble.
To have a certain mass.
defs.ex: I mass 70 kilograms.

defs.d: Involving a mass of things; concerning a large quantity or number.
defs.ex: There is evidence of mass extinctions in the distant past.

defs.d: Involving a mass of people; of, for, or by the masses.
defs.ex: Mass unemployment resulted from the financial collapse.

defs.d: To lament.
To intend.
To convey (a meaning).
(now chiefly in the plural) A method or course of action used to achieve some result.
(in the singular) An intermediate step or intermediate steps.
The management of money and other assets.
The science of management of money and other assets.
To conduct, or procure money for, financial operations; manage finances.
To pay ransom.
With zealous fervor; excited, motivated.
defs.ex: an enthusiastic lover of art

defs.d: The action of opposing or of being in conflict.
An opposite or contrasting position.
A person or organisation with some sort of responsibility for another person or organisation, especially where the responsibility has a religious, legal, or financial aspect.
defs.ex: He was my sponsor when I applied to join the club.

defs.d: One that pays all or part of the cost of an event, a publication, or a media program, usually in exchange for advertising time.
defs.ex: And now a word from our sponsor.

defs.d: To be a sponsor for.
To yield or give way to another.
defs.ex: They will not submit to the destruction of their rights.

defs.d: To yield (something) to another, as when defeated.
